items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Ottie on congas and Beaver Harris on drums. That was his band.

ctx.x: Ottie on congas and Beaver Harris on drums. That was his band.

I hadn't been down there since the '60s. But I played. We played that weekend and that's where I met my wife Gloria. She was sitting there at the bar, loved music and we talked for -- a musician that knew me introduced me to her. I didn't know she was a schoolteacher or nothing like that. She was just a lady and kind enough to put -- she knew Dave Burrell. She knew Dave and his wife. So, she said, "Well, instead of commuting back to New York, why don't you stay out at my house?"
